context:
Goal: you hear the same day when a main job ends at its time cap.
Problem (rule): PR #2745 (the CI alarm names a main job that ends at its time cap) opens no issue for a failed run that a newer green run clears, because decision no-merge-onto-red-main says the alarm opens no issue for a run the merge step calls clear. Your alarm ruling did not make that exception, so it needs your word.
Based on (ruling): owner 11:53 CST Nov 11: an alarm the same day when a main job ends at its cap; coordinator 08:04 CST Nov 12, pick a: a cap end after a green re-run is named on a notice line, not an issue.
Based on (read): decision no-merge-onto-red-main: "The CI alarm ... opens no issue for a run the merge tool calls clear."
Departs from: main — adds a same-day alarm for a main job that ends at its time cap; this question sets whether a cleared run is exempt.
Corrected 11:40 CST Nov 12, from the alarm script in #2745 (the pull request that adds the cap alarm): a failed run that the merge tool calls clear opens no issue and gets no notice line. A cap end in a cancelled run still alarms, even when cleared. The notice line is only for a cap end in an earlier attempt of a run whose latest attempt is green. So option a closes a narrower gap than it reads: cap ends in cleared failed runs only.
Meanwhile: the cap alarm pull request waits as a draft; its wiring waits on another open pull request.

options.gain: Every cap end reaches you the same day, as you ruled.
options.how: The cap alarm checks cap ends before the clear rule; the red-run alarm keeps the clear rule.
options.label: Open an issue for every cap end on main, cleared or not (Recommended)
options.lose: An issue for a run the merge step already cleared.

options.gain: No issue for a run already cleared.
options.label: A cleared run gets a notice line only
options.lose: The notice line sits in a CI log no one reads, so that cap end does not reach you.

reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: every cap end on main alarms, cleared or not (PR #2745, step main-job-cap-alarm). Changed 13:07 CST by your ruling R53: the alarm wakes the batch runner, which fixes it or brings it to the coordinator; it opens no GitHub issue.
short: Cap alarm: run cleared by a newer green
title: When a main job ends at its time cap in a run that a newer green run clears, should the same-day alarm still open an issue?
why: Recommended: a. Your ruling asked to hear about every cap end the same day, and a notice line has no reader.
